subtasks: Pick up two slices of bread, place them into the toaster, and press the lever down.
Pick up the fallen bread slice behind the rack and seat it upright in an empty toaster slot.
Lift the rightmost upright slice from the bread rack and seat it upright in the left toaster slot.
Pick up the flat bread slice between the rack and toaster, turn it upright, and seat it in the empty right toaster slot.
Pick up the upright bread slice beside the toaster and seat it upright in the empty right toaster slot.
Use the right gripper to pick up the fallen slice from the toaster rim, turn it upright, and seat it in the right slot while the left gripper keeps the other slice clear.
Seat the upright slice held in the left gripper into the empty left toaster slot and release it. Move the empty right gripper clear.
